name: Tabs
purpose: Organizes content into a set of selectable tab panels.
scenarios: Browse content categories without leaving the page
Use arrow keys to move between tabs in RTL

items.description: Array of tabs with value, label, and content.

onChange.description: Receives the next active tab value.

states.name: default
states.description: A tab is active and its panel is visible.

antiPatterns: Do not nest tabs inside tabs.
Do not use tabs when the content should be visible at once.

keyboard: Tab moves to the active tab
Tab moves into the tab panel
a11y.focus: Visible focus indicator on tab triggers; roving tabindex is handled by the primitive.
a11y.labeling: Each tab is labelled by its visible text; each panel is associated with its tab.

responsive.strategy: Tab list scrolls horizontally when it overflows. Active tab stays visible.

breakpoints.compact: Tab list may overflow horizontally; users can swipe/scroll.
breakpoints.medium: Tab list fits the available width.
breakpoints.large: Tab list fits the available width.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Tab order follows the document direction; arrow-key roving is handled by the primitive.
